name: Status Extension Rejection Notification V 03
definition: Scope|The StatusExtensionRejectionNotification message is sent by the matching application to the submitter of a request to extend the status of a transaction.|This message is used to inform about the rejection of a request to extend the status of a transaction.|Usage|The StatusExtensionRejectionNotification message can be sent by the matching application to pass on information about the rejection of a request to extend the status of a transaction that it has obtained through the receipt of a StatusExtensionRejection message.|In order to pass on information about the acceptance of a request to extend the status of a transaction the matching application sends a StatusExtensionNotification message.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the transaction.|This identification is to be used in any communication between the parties.|.

EstablishedBaselineIdentification.name: Established Baseline Identification
EstablishedBaselineIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the baseline when it is established.

NonExtendedStatus.name: Non Extended Status
NonExtendedStatus.definition: Identifies the status of the transaction that is not extended.

UserTransactionReference.name: User Transaction Reference
UserTransactionReference.definition: Reference to the transaction for each financial institution which is a party to the transaction.

RejectionReason.name: Rejection Reason
RejectionReason.definition: Reason why the user cannot accept the request.

RequestForAction.name: Request For Action
RequestForAction.definition: Information on the next processing step required.
